the identification of factors that influence patient adherence to medication and lifestyle therapy in T2DM.
the role of adherence determinants, especially the psychosocial and psychological factors in T2DM.
the importance of the role of adherence in diabetes management and the association between the different types of adherence.

the patient’s adherence to medication and diet is influenced by the duration of the disease.
the patient’s adherence to diabetes therapy is determined by the psychosocial and demographic variables, which are also associated with the type of adherence.
adherence to medication and lifestyle therapy in T2DM is a complex issue, and the patient’s motivation is the main factor in adherence to the prescribed treatment.

the psychosocial and demographic variables of patients play an important role in adherence to medication, dieting, blood glucose monitoring, and exercise.
